title: CYBRIK model inference result v1
description: Provider-neutral result for a runtime that DID respond (completed/refused/filtered). Transport/runtime failures that produce no result use cybrik.model-inference-error.v1 instead. tenant_id is REQUIRED and control-written; the model never populates identity/authority. The output is UNTRUSTED data: it can never be interpreted as authorization, delegation, or approval. A refusal is surfaced as data (outcome='refused'), never dropped. Any fallback substitution is surfaced explicitly. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED (v0.1.0).

request_id.description: Echoes the request's request_id for correlation.

tenant_id.description: Control-written authoritative tenant of the result. Never populated from model output.

model_class.description: The class actually served. If a fallback occurred this equals fallback.to_model_class and `fallback` is present; the requested class is recoverable from fallback.from_model_class. Still a neutral class token — never a concrete vendor/model id.

output.description: The model output. UNTRUSTED data with no authority semantics. Object when output_contract (structured output) was requested and satisfied; string for free-form text. Absent/empty for outcome != 'completed'.

refusal_reason.description: Present when outcome='refused'. Vendor-neutral, human-readable reason the model declined. Never an authorization signal.

filter_reason.description: Present when outcome='filtered'. Vendor-neutral content-filter reason token/description.

data_marking.description: Authoritative marking of the OUTPUT. Runtime invariant (enforced control-side, not by schema): output marking MUST be >= the request's input marking — inference never downgrades sensitivity.
